definitions: A joining or merging of different parts or qualities in which the component elements are individually distinct.
A sequence of numbers or letters used to open a combination lock.
A set of numbers or objects selected from a larger set where the order of selection does not matter.
An undergarment combining a camisole and knickers or a vest and shorts.
examples: The dish was a delicious combination of sweet and sour.
He tried several combinations before the safe opened.
There are many combinations possible with these ingredients.
She wore a silk combination under her dress.
